cand.question: Does the hyperbolic defect -chi = 1 - 1/p - 1/q - 1/r >= 1/12 impose an absolute lower bound on the canonical height of rational points on triangle orbifolds Delta(p, q, r)?
cand.context: Triangle orbifolds with p,q,r >= 3 have negative Euler characteristic bounded away from zero by -chi >= 1/12. Does Arakelov intersection theory yield an effective height bound independent of (p, q, r)?
